factual_grounding_and_kpis.justification: All core KPIs (AOV $456, Total Volume $456,000, Avg Quantity 2.51, Female Share 51%) are exact mathematical representations of the Ground Truth. Outliers and statistical bounds (e.g., max revenue $2,000, max price $500, top date 2023-05-16 with 11 sales) are perfectly aligned with empirical stats.

chart_relevance_and_validity.justification: 100% schema compliance with zero hallucinated columns. Chart selection matches statistical best practices (Pie for binary categorical split, Bar for categorical aggregation, Histogram for numeric distribution, Box plot for variance, Scatter for correlation).

analytical_depth_and_trends.justification: The agent extracted meaningful cross-sectional insight including seasonality metrics, demographic spread, category distributions, and multi-dimensional anomaly detection.

strategic_actionability.justification: Recommendations are executive-grade, highly actionable, realistic, and directly tied to empirical findings (e.g., targeting the 29-53 demographic bracket, capitalizing on mid-May traffic spikes, introducing female loyalty tiers).

schema_and_structure_compliance.justification: The agent strictly followed all structural requirements, producing clear markdown sections and flawless JSON objects for KPIs and chart specs.

strengths: Flawless KPI calculations and exact alignment with empirical Ground Truth data.
Zero column hallucinations across structured chart definitions.
Highly tailored strategic business recommendations directly derived from data distributions.
weaknesses: Minor narrative rounding inaccuracy: Product category breakdown in narrative text slightly flipped Electronics (34.2% actual vs 30% reported) and Beauty (30.7% actual vs 35% reported).
